description: Reusable authored-pose direction for warlord player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies commanding banner-and-weapon choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: commanding, disciplined, expansive, and battle-tested, with deliberate signals, authoritative footwork, and controlled banner and weapon inertia
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's ornate armor, command insignia, banner or standard, weapon, cape, and exact item count. Keep each item in its original hand or mount; never duplicate, swap, discard, or transform it.
identity.magicRule: Leadership effects are physical signals rather than spells. Do not add runes, aura, projectiles, or magical troops; restrained dust, cloth motion, or a metal glint may support the action.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, ornate armor, command insignia, banner, weapon, cape, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact authoritative silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. The complete silhouette including banner finial, crossbar, cloth, cape, weapon tip, and boots must occupy no more than 70% of the canvas width and height, leaving at least 15% empty background on every edge. Scale the warlord and compact standard down substantially; never crop or crowd any equipment. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered warlord in a commanding field stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall warlord motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, armor, insignia, palette, proportions, banner, cape, and weapon. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A vigilant command loop alternates battlefield scans, banner control, and measured weight shifts while the weapon remains ready.
idle.effectRule: No active attack or magic; banner cloth, cape, and armor settle subtly.
frameDescriptions: command stance with banner and weapon controlled
measured inhale while surveying the far field
weight shifts forward as the weapon indicates a sector
banner hand firms against a light cloth response
centered commanding midpoint
controlled exhale as the weapon lowers slightly
weight shifts rearward while scanning the opposite flank
command stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: An authoritative alternating march uses crisp contacts, armor compression, weapon counter-motion, and delayed banner and cape follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No attack effect or magic; banner, cape, straps, and armor respond to the marching cadence.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact beneath the raised standard
left leg compressed under decorated armor
passing pose with weapon balancing the banner
right foot reaches as cloth trails behind
right foot forward in a decisive plant
right leg compresses while the standard stays upright
passing pose with left knee advancing
left foot reaches into the command march

attack.motionDirection: A sharp command gesture becomes a planted weapon windup, decisive forward strike, authoritative follow-through, and immediate battlefield-ready recovery.
attack.effectRule: A short physical weapon-swish accent may mark contact; no magical soldiers, projectile, or effect obscuring hands, weapon, or standard.
frameDescriptions: commanding guard while assessing the target
weapon points a crisp advance signal
deep windup while the standard arm counterbalances
committed forward step beginning the strike
decisive weapon contact with torso fully rotated
broad follow-through as banner cloth snaps behind
weapon retracts while posture regains authority
recovered command guard

hurt.motionDirection: An impact disrupts command posture into a hard stagger, banner-assisted balance catch, defiant rise, and renewed control.
hurt.effectRule: One compact physical impact accent only; no gore, blood, magic, dropped standard, or duplicated equipment.
frameDescriptions: command guard before impact
sharp flinch with banner and weapon retained
maximum stagger as cape and banner swing wide
forced backward step with torso recoiling
low balance catch using the standard shaft or planted stance
defiant rise with chin and weapon lifting
feet and banner reset into alignment
recovered commanding guard

death.motionDirection: A final hit silences the command, standard lowers, knees fail, the decorated body collapses sideways, and equipment settles into a fully fallen pose.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, magic, or rigid rotation. Keep the standard, weapon, and insignia recognizable and singular throughout.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact breaks the command stance
weapon lowers and standard tilts as balance fails
both knees buckle beneath the armor
one knee grounds while the body turns sideways
body and standard reach full ground contact
cape, banner cloth, and limbs settle low
final fully fallen warlord with equipment at rest
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The warlord confirms victory, signals the field secure, plants the standard, raises the weapon, opens into a decorated heroic stance, and holds command.
victory.effectRule: No spell effect; banner motion and a small metal glint may carry the physical salute.
frameDescriptions: measured recognition of victory
weapon gives a crisp field-secure signal
